connector.name: Hub-Equity MCP
connector.registryDescription: Standardized, restatement-aware SEC + European (ESEF) XBRL fundamentals, served to your agent.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package hub-equity-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.hub-equity, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: HUBEQUITY_API_KEY
env.description: Optional hubq_ API key. Unlocks premium (Pro/Enterprise) tools and raises the rate limit. Omit to run anonymously (60 requests/minute, base tools only).
